drafts.rationale: EV-K-A1 states each delivery job may have no more than three delivery attempts in total, and the first attempt is included in that limit.

value.text: No more than three delivery attempts in total, including the first attempt

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A2 states each job begins with one original attempt and, if it fails, the worker may make up to three additional retry attempts.

value.text: One original delivery attempt plus up to three additional retry attempts if that attempt fails
